response.original_title: La larga noche de la mañana de Napalpí
response.overview: On July 19, 1924, hundreds of people from the Qom and Mocoví-Moqoit indigenous communities were massacred by police and local landowners' paramilitary groups. Decades later, the Truth Trial for the Napalpí massacre was initiated. More than 30 people who managed to survive by hiding when they were still children became the key witnesses.
response.title: La larga noche de la mañana de Napalpí
